What strike on Russian ship in Libya says about spread of Ukraine war
items.description: Ukraine's sinking of a Russian battleship at a port in Libya raises the stakes of the war a notch, writes Frank Gardner.

items.title: How far will Ukraine war spread? Kyiv targets Russian vessels in Libya
items.description: Talk about spillover. In the Libyan port of Benghazi, Ukraine claiming responsibility for the sinkings first of a Russian warship and then a cargo vessel. That’s on top of the sanctioned ship struck in the Baltic Sea that’s since strayed into Finland’s waters. Legitimate targets?

items.title: More than 700,000 Russian Soldiers Killed in Ukraine War, New Analysis Finds
items.description: More than 700,000 Russian soldiers have been killed during the nearly-five-year-old war on Ukraine, according to a new analysis, a staggering figure that highlights Moscow's intent on conquering Ukrainian territory -- and Ukraine's intent on inflicting mass casualties. items.title: Attacks on two Russian ships in Libyan waters mark new turn in Ukraine war
items.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky claimed seven naval drones carried out two attacks off the coast of Benghazi. The attack on Russian vessels transporting weaponry demonstrates Kyiv's capacity to strike Moscow's interests wherever they might be.

items.title: Gaza mourns UNRWA worker killed in Israeli strike
items.description: Palestinians mourned UNRWA employee Adel al-Helou, who was killed on Monday in an Israeli airstrike while on duty

items.title: Zelenskyy hails Ukraine's attack on a Russian warship docked at a naval base in Libya
items.description: Ukraine carried out an attack on a Russian warship moored at a port in Libya, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said, claiming that sea drones sank the navy vessel in a surprise assault.

items.title: Libya’s Eastern Government Suspects Drone Attack Caused Explosion on Russian Ship
items.description: The government stressed that Libya was not a party to the war between Russia and Ukraine, saying its relations with friendly countries were a sovereign matter.

items.title: Russian helicopter suspected of violating Finnish airspace
items.description: Finland's Defense Ministry thinks the incursion is linked to a drone strike earlier Saturday on a Russian cargo ship, which is on a US sanctions list.
